verdict.rationale: OpenAI maintains a standing deprecations page listing dated model shutdowns with recommended replacements, and the changelog points to it for upcoming deprecations. That covers the core of tracking retirements and knowing what to migrate to. The evidence does not document a formal policy with a guaranteed advance-notice window or any proactive notification to affected developers, and migration guidance appears to be a replacement-model pointer rather than detailed model-migration steps. missing for 10: an explicit deprecation policy stating a minimum notice period, a documented notification mechanism for affected users, detailed per-model migration guides, and independent corroboration that notice is given in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired

citations.quote: A standing deprecations page tracks dated shutdowns with pricing and recommended replacements per model
Upcoming deprecations are listed on the deprecations page
